import { html } from 'common-tags'

export const registryItem = {
  type: 'registry:ui',
  name: 'tags-input',
  title: 'Tags Input',

  description: html`
    Tag inputs render tags inside an input, followed by an actual text input.

    References:
    - Headless API: https://ark-ui.com/docs/components/tags-input
    - shadcn/ui: https://shadcn-vue.com/docs/components/tags-input
  `,

  dependencies: [
    '@ark-ui/vue',
    '@vueuse/core',
    'lucide-vue-next',
  ],
}

export default registryItem

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

import { TagsInput } from '@/components/ui/tags-input'

const modelValue = ref(['Apple', 'Banana'])
</script>

<template>
  <TagsInput.Root v-model="modelValue">
    <TagsInput.Control>
      <TagsInput.Item
        v-for="(item, index) in modelValue"
        :key="item"
        :index="index"
        :value="item"
      >
        <TagsInput.ItemPreview>
          <TagsInput.ItemText>{{ item }}</TagsInput.ItemText>
          <TagsInput.ItemDelete />
        </TagsInput.ItemPreview>

        <TagsInput.ItemInput />
      </TagsInput.Item>

      <TagsInput.Input
        placeholder="Fruits..."
        aria-label="Fruits"
        class="basis-full"
      />
    </TagsInput.Control>
  </TagsInput.Root>
</template>
